system.description: A Focus for a character who heals allies, restores their strength, and can bend time to help them.

abilities.name: Easing the Pain
abilities.description: Allies within immediate range add +1 to recovery rolls.

abilities.name: Healing Hand
abilities.description: Touch a creature to reduce the severity of one wound. The Intellect cost increases with each use and resets after a recovery. Last action.

abilities.name: Resilience
abilities.description: You can take one additional moderate wound.

abilities.name: Alleviate Malady
abilities.description: Touch a creature and attempt an Intellect roll to cancel or cure a disease, poison, or similar malady. Action.

abilities.name: Healing Beacon
abilities.description: Choose an ally within short range to reduce one of their wounds whenever you use Healing Hand or a similar healing ability. Action to initiate.

abilities.name: Font of Healing
abilities.description: An ally touching you can spend Intellect to heal two minor wounds, one moderate wound, or one major wound. Each ally can use this once per ten-hour recovery.

abilities.name: Font of Recovery
abilities.description: An ally touching you can spend 1 Intellect to regain 1d6 Might or Speed. Each ally can use this once per ten-hour recovery.

abilities.name: Healing Shield
abilities.description: Give an ally within short range an asset for one block roll. The ability renews after a recovery.

abilities.name: Resuscitate
abilities.description: Touch an injured PC to heal one major wound, one moderate wound, or three minor wounds; you can also revive a recently dead creature under the stated conditions. Action.

abilities.name: Ranged Healer
abilities.description: Your short-range healing abilities work at long range, and your touch abilities work at short range.

abilities.name: Rewind Time
abilities.description: Rewind a few seconds for a creature within short range so it can repeat or change its most recent action. Renews after a recovery.

abilities.name: Greater Healing Hand
abilities.description: Remove all minor wounds from a touched character, or reduce two moderate or two major wounds. The Intellect cost increases with each use and resets after a recovery.

abilities.name: Superior Healer
abilities.description: Double the benefit of Font abilities, Resuscitate, or Healing Shield as applicable. Effort can extend Resuscitate's death time limit.
